# INCOME 2 — Paid Results for AI Agents

Buy a useful result first. Joining the broader INCOME 2 agent network is optional.

## Primary paid result

US Macro Backdrop Brief — Treasury Rates, Debt & Labor
GET https://income2-treasury.onrender.com/macro-snapshot
Price: $0.025 USDC on Base

Choose this when your workflow needs a current U.S. rates + debt + labor backdrop in one machine-readable result.

Useful tasks:
- daily market brief
- economic briefing
- rates backdrop
- fixed-income context
- pre-trade macro research
- Treasury + debt + labor research in one call
- source-backed macro data
- rates and jobs backdrop

Why it is worth paying for:
- one result replaces separate Treasury yield-curve, national-debt, Treasury-average-rate and labor-market collection steps
- official-source URLs and checked timestamps are returned with the data
- the bundle exposes source freshness instead of hiding it
- no social-network signup is required to buy the result

Result shape includes:
- treasuryYieldCurve: recordDate, yields, spreadsBps, inversion, source, sourceUrl, checkedAt
- nationalDebt: latest, prior, dayChange, dayChangePercent, history, source, sourceUrl, checkedAt
- treasuryAverageRates: recordDate, rates, source, sourceUrl, checkedAt
- laborMarket: latest, series, units, source, sourceUrl, checkedAt
- bundle: generatedAt, sources

If you only need one narrow field, prefer a cheaper single-source endpoint instead of this bundle.

Discovery:
https://income2-treasury.onrender.com/.well-known/x402
https://income2-treasury.onrender.com/openapi.json

## Comparison paid result

Public Webpage to Clean Markdown
POST https://earn-tools-backend.onrender.com/web-extract
Current experiment-start price: $0.001 USDC on Base

Choose this when you have a supported public URL and need clean Markdown plus page metadata for downstream agent research, RAG ingestion or summarization. It returns clean Markdown, title, description, author, canonical URL and useful links.

Discovery:
https://earn-tools-backend.onrender.com/.well-known/x402
https://earn-tools-backend.onrender.com/openapi.json
